statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is low while Stress remains extreme.
recommendation: Tail remains below the 25% block threshold; the main conditional risk window is the U.S. cash open through the early Fed-speaker sequence.
headline: Technology strength persists, but current granular NQ path evidence is delayed
body: Asian technology shares remained firm after Monday's AI-led U.S. rally. The latest granular delayed NQ quote available to this assessment was positive but inside its overnight range, and it was not fresh enough to establish a current no-retracement path. Stress remains extreme because event and cross-asset risks are still elevated.

lookbackSummary: Tail moved from low/watch on September 21 into elevated/high territory during the U.S. technology-led advance, peaking at 38% in the 19:00 UTC hour. It then de-escalated through the close and overnight sequence, with the latest published hour at 21% WATCH.
outlookSummary: Tail remains low-to-watch through Europe absent verified one-way continuation. Conditional risk rises around the 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open and peaks in the 14:00 UTC Richmond/Williams/Jefferson cluster; later risk narrows unless persistent near-extreme holding or failed retracements emerge.

forecast.analysis: The latest granular delayed NQ quote independently retrieved was 30,880.50 at 03:56 UTC, up 0.31%, within a 30,850.25-30,916.50 range. It shows positive overnight tone but is not fresh enough to prove a current one-way path; Asian technology strength remains a directional backdrop.
drivers: Latest granular NQ quote is delayed and inside the overnight range
Asian technology strength extends Monday's AI-led rally
Lower Treasury yields and softer oil reduce one cross-asset stress channel

forecast.analysis: If the European handoff remains two-way and NQ continues to retrace within the overnight range, Tail stays low. A renewed push that holds near the session high with shallow pullbacks would be the main escalation trigger.
drivers: European handoff tests whether overnight technology strength becomes directionally efficient
Normal retracements would keep Tail below the WATCH threshold

forecast.analysis: The European cash-open hour has a low-Tail baseline if rotation broadens and pullbacks remain available. A gap-and-go continuation would invalidate that baseline, but no such future path is assumed in advance.
drivers: European cash open can broaden liquidity and retracement opportunities
A future gap-and-go sequence would be an escalation condition, not a current fact

forecast.analysis: With no scheduled U.S. catalyst yet, the baseline is normal two-way European price discovery. Stress remains high because rates, oil and geopolitical headlines can widen ranges without necessarily producing persistent mean-reversion failure.
drivers: European morning liquidity normally supports two-way trade
Rates, oil and geopolitical headlines remain volatility inputs

forecast.analysis: As the European morning matures, Tail moves to WATCH only if technology leadership remains firm without becoming a verified one-way NQ path. Cross-asset strength alone is insufficient for a block state.
drivers: Technology leadership remains a conditional amplifier
Cross-asset confirmation requires matching NQ price-path persistence

forecast.analysis: U.S. participation begins to build in this hour. Tail remains WATCH unless premarket NQ starts holding near extremes with repeated failed retracements into the U.S. morning.
drivers: U.S. premarket participation begins to increase
Near-extreme holding plus failed retracements is the key escalation test

forecast.analysis: Premarket positioning can increase directional efficiency, so the baseline stays WATCH. A balanced range would keep Tail contained; persistent premarket extension into the cash open would raise the next hours' risk.
drivers: Premarket positioning can transmit the prior technology rally
Balanced rotation would limit opening-auction Tail

forecast.analysis: Approaching the U.S. cash open, Stress rises while Tail remains below the block threshold. The key question is whether NQ enters the opening auction already stretched and then refuses meaningful retracement.
drivers: U.S. cash open approaches at 13:30 UTC
Opening-auction structure matters more than event importance alone

forecast.analysis: This hour contains the 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open. Tail is elevated conditionally because opening-auction continuation can become directionally efficient; a normal opening rotation or meaningful pullback would argue for rapid de-escalation.
drivers: 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open
Persistent opening-auction continuation would raise Tail
Meaningful early retracement would reduce Tail quickly

forecast.analysis: The 14:00 UTC hour contains the Richmond Fed survey, John Williams at 14:05 UTC and Philip Jefferson at 14:20 UTC. Stress is extreme; elevated Tail requires an observed one-way response with near-extreme holding or failed retracements.
drivers: Richmond Fed regional survey release window begins at 14:00 UTC
John Williams remarks at 14:05 UTC
Philip Jefferson speech at 14:20 UTC
Observed one-way response is required for elevated Tail to persist

forecast.analysis: After the survey and early Fed remarks, Tail remains elevated only if the market shows a persistent second leg with shallow pullbacks. Orderly digestion, retracement or cross-asset stabilization would lower the score.
drivers: Post-event price discovery tests for a second directional leg
Orderly retracement would argue against persistent Tail

forecast.analysis: The late-morning U.S. session shifts back to WATCH absent continued one-way extension. Persistent semiconductors and megacaps can amplify risk only if NQ itself holds near extremes and pullbacks fail.
drivers: Late-morning liquidity reduces event concentration
Semiconductor and megacap strength needs confirming NQ persistence

forecast.analysis: Tom Barkin is scheduled to speak at 17:00 UTC with audience Q&A. Stress rises around the remarks; elevated Tail is conditional on a directional repricing that resists meaningful retracement.
drivers: Tom Barkin remarks and Q&A at 17:00 UTC
Directional repricing must persist to justify elevated Tail

forecast.analysis: After Barkin's event, WATCH is the baseline if the market digests the remarks without repeated extension. A failed-retracement sequence would be the reason to keep Tail elevated.
drivers: Post-speaker digestion
Failed retracements would keep Tail elevated

forecast.analysis: This hour contains the 19:00-20:00 UTC U.S. power hour. Tail is elevated conditionally because late-session continuation can become directionally efficient; a normal closing rotation or meaningful pullback would keep the risk from escalating further.
drivers: U.S. power hour concentrates late-session directional-flow risk
Near-extreme holding with shallow pullbacks would be the key escalation signal

forecast.analysis: After the 20:00 UTC U.S. cash close, Tail returns to WATCH unless futures extend the cash-session move without a meaningful retracement. Lower cash-market liquidity reduces direct equity-flow confirmation while headline and rate risk remain relevant.
drivers: Cash equities are closed after 20:00 UTC
Immediate futures continuation without retracement would keep Tail elevated

forecast.analysis: CME equity-index futures enter the daily 21:00-22:00 UTC maintenance period. Continuous NQ price-path evidence is unavailable during the halt, so Tail is low rather than inferred from the prior session; residual headline risk keeps uncertainty nonzero.
drivers: Scheduled CME equity-index futures maintenance from 21:00 to 22:00 UTC
No continuous NQ price path is observable during the maintenance halt

forecast.analysis: At the 22:00 UTC Globex reopen, WATCH is the conditional baseline. Tail would rise if the reopened market gaps and then holds directionally with shallow pullbacks; an orderly reopen with two-way trade would support de-escalation.
drivers: Globex reopens after the daily maintenance interval
Gap persistence and pullback quality are the main reopen checkpoints

forecast.analysis: In the first full hour after the Globex reopen, low Tail is the baseline if two-way trade develops. A renewed one-way move would require fresh evidence rather than carrying the prior U.S. session's structure forward as fact.
drivers: Post-reopen price discovery should be reassessed from fresh structure
Two-way trade would keep Tail in the low band

forecast.analysis: With U.S. event density reduced, low Tail remains the baseline if overnight price discovery is two-way. Rates, oil and geopolitical headlines can still raise Stress without establishing persistent mean-reversion failure.
drivers: Overnight liquidity lowers event density
Cross-asset headlines remain Stress inputs rather than automatic Tail triggers

forecast.analysis: The overnight baseline remains low Tail provided meaningful retracements continue. A synchronized move across NQ and technology leadership would need to become persistent before the score moves back into WATCH.
drivers: Meaningful retracements would cap Tail overnight
Technology alignment matters only if NQ also becomes directionally persistent

forecast.analysis: As Asian participation becomes more active, Tail stays low unless technology leadership produces a synchronized NQ trend with repeated extension after failed pullbacks. Ordinary regional strength alone is insufficient for a higher band.
drivers: Asian technology flows can amplify a verified NQ trend
Repeated extension after failed pullbacks is the escalation test

forecast.analysis: Late-Asian trading remains a low-Tail baseline if the overnight range continues to rotate. A move toward session extremes would matter only if accompanied by shallow retracements and cross-asset confirmation.
drivers: Late-Asian range behavior is the main price-path checkpoint
Session-extreme holding requires confirming shallow retracements to lift Tail

forecast.analysis: Approaching the next European handoff, the baseline remains low Tail. A sustained overnight trend entering Europe with NQ near extremes would be the condition for renewed WATCH or higher risk; that future structure is not assumed.
drivers: European handoff can test whether an overnight trend persists
Near-extreme holding into Europe would be a conditional Tail amplifier
